exposure: informed consent process (information provided regarding C-section necessity, risks, benefits, anesthesia, right to refuse)
outcome: adequacy of the informed consent process
cohort: Patients over 18 years of age (average 26.11 years) who underwent elective or emergency caesarean section.
finding: Most patients were well-informed about the necessity, risks, and benefits of C-section, but lacked information regarding the type of anesthesia and their right to refuse the procedure.
cross-section timing: After patients underwent elective or emergency caesarean section.
